p.src: 1  Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

en: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
u.src: 1  Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

p.src: 2  Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

ja: が不義をその人のものとみなさず、 その霊に欺きのない
en: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
u.src: 2  Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

p.src: 3  When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

en: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
u.src: 3  When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

p.src: 4  For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

ja: くのしかかったからだ。
の日照りのようにしぼんだ。 セラ。
en: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
u.src: 4  For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

p.src: 5  I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

ja: をあなたに認めた。 私は
しよう」と。 すると、あなたは
してくださった。 セラ。
en: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
u.src: 5  I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

p.src: 6  For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

ja: が氾濫するときにも、それが彼に及ぶことはない。
en: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
u.src: 6  For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

p.src: 7  You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

en: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
u.src: 7  You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

p.src: 8  I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

ja: はあなたに目を留めて、
en: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
u.src: 8  I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

p.src: 9  Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

ja: やろばのようになってはならない。 くつわと
で抑えなければ、あなたに近づこうとしないもののように。
en: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
u.src: 9  Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

p.src: 10  Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.

en: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.
u.src: 10  Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.

p.src: 11  Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

ja: のまっすぐなすべての
en: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
u.src: 11  Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
